summary: Math helper that builds a plane (normal + offset) from three triangle corner points. Treats a2 as the reference corner and a3/a4 as the other two: computes the cross product of the edge vectors (a2-a3) and (a2-a4) to form the plane normal, stores the three normal components into the output float[4] a1 (offsets 0, 4, 8), invokes ThunkTo, then writes the plane offset as -(dot(normal, a2)) into a1[3] (offset 0xC). Returns the output pointer a1. ABI name PlaneFromTriangle is LEGACY-trust; behavior matches that name structurally.

local_names.a1: output plane, float[4]: normal.x, normal.y, normal.z at +0/+4/+8 and plane offset at +0xC
local_names.a2: reference corner of the triangle; also the anchor point used for the plane offset term
local_names.v4: a2[0] - a3[0], first edge x component
local_names.v5: a2[1] - a3[1], first edge y component
local_names.v6: a2[2] - a3[2], first edge z component
local_names.v12: a2[0] - a4[0], second edge x component
local_names.v13: a2[1] - a4[1], second edge y component
local_names.v7: a2[2] - a4[2], second edge z component
local_names.v9: cross product x component of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4)
local_names.v10: cross product y component of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4)
local_names.v11: cross product z component of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4)

operations.description: v4 = a2[0] - a3[0]: first edge (a2-a3) x component
v5 = a2[1] - a3[1]: first edge (a2-a3) y component
v6 = a2[2] - a3[2]: first edge (a2-a3) z component
v12 = a2[0] - a4[0]: second edge (a2-a4) x component
v13 = a2[1] - a4[1]: second edge (a2-a4) y component
v7 = a2[2] - a4[2]: second edge (a2-a4) z component
v9 = v7*v5 - v13*v6: cross product x of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4), i.e. plane normal.x
v10 = v6*v12 - v7*v4: cross product y of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4), i.e. plane normal.y
v11 = v13*v4 - v12*v5: cross product z of (a2-a3) x (a2-a4), i.e. plane normal.z
a1[0] = v9: write plane normal.x into output offset 0x0
a1[1] = v10: write plane normal.y into output offset 0x4
a1[2] = v11: write plane normal.z into output offset 0x8
ThunkTo() invoked with no arguments between the normal writes and the offset computation
a1[3] = -(a1[2]*a2[2] + a1[1]*a2[1] + a1[0]*a2[0]): plane offset = -dot(normal, a2), anchored at the reference corner; written into output offset 0xC
Returns the output pointer a1 (the completed plane float[4])
